items.exampleEn: My daughter likes to draw cats.
There is a big television in the living room.
The singer is on the stage.
I like the design of this bag.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡這個包包的設計。

items.sentenceEn: He got the first goal of the game.
items.sentenceZh: 他踢進了這場比賽的第一球。

items.audioEn: Don't watch TV now. Do your homework first.
items.audioZh: 現在不要看電視，先寫功課。

items.sentenceEn: We have a new television in the living room.
items.sentenceZh: 我們客廳有一台新電視。

items.sentenceEn: Don't throw your bag on the floor.

items.stemEn: Can you ____ a picture of your family?
items.stemZh: 你可以畫一張你家人的圖嗎？
足球是我最喜歡的運動。

items.passageEn: Tina likes art and design. She draws pictures every day. At school, she makes the posters for the school concert. The concert is on a big stage. Her brother does not like art. He likes sport, and he watches soccer on TV all day.
items.passageZh: Tina 喜歡藝術和設計，她每天都畫畫。在學校，她負責製作學校音樂會的海報。音樂會在一個大舞台上舉行。她哥哥不喜歡藝術，他喜歡運動，整天都在看電視上的足球比賽。

questions.questionZh: Tina 在學校為什麼製作海報？
Tina 的哥哥喜歡做什麼？

rubricZh: 問最喜歡的東西例如用 What is your favorite …?（可縮寫成 What's）
寫 Which sport do you like best? 也正確
favorite 放在名詞前面（英式拼法 favourite 也正確）

items.instructionZh: 用 draw 造一個句子，說說你會畫或喜歡畫什麼。
rubricZh: draw 後面接畫的內容（例如 draw flowers）
can、like to 後面接動詞原形（例如 can draw、like to draw）
